verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its own mechanism for carrying tokens across devices: TOTP codes live in the synced vault, and the Authenticator app can be connected to Password Manager so codes stay synchronized. It also documents importing tokens from other authenticators, such as Google Authenticator via QR code and 2FAS backup files. Nothing describes a dedicated, guided new-phone migration that moves all tokens in one step, so delivery of the story's 'one guided step' is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit guided device-migration flow, documentation that every token transfers to a new phone in one step, and hands-on corroboration of a phone switch.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
